title: Finanzen · Burnrate
description: Einnahmen, Konsum und Burnrate je Seite (Ich, Gemeinschaftskonto) und für den Haushalt. Ohne Mama.

list.name: laufend
list.label: Laufender Monat
list.description: Der laufende Monat ist unvollständig und standardmäßig ausgeblendet.

list.name: notgroschen
list.label: Notgroschen-Konten
list.query:
SELECT a.name || ' (' || a.person || ')' AS __text, a.id AS __value
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.person = 'me' AND NOT a.portfolio AND a.active AND a.currency = 'EUR'
  AND a.account_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'Loan account' AND a.account_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'Credit card'
ORDER BY a.name

list.name: einmalgrenze
list.label: Einmalgrenze (€)
list.description: Jede einzelne Konsumbuchung ab diesem Betrag gilt als einmalig, außer wiederkehrende Buchungen unter Wohnen › Wohnung.

list.name: ausgeschlossen
list.label: Ausgeschlossen
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p AS __value,
       CASE WHEN p IS NULL THEN '(ohne Kategorie)'
         WHEN starts_with(p, 'Ein-/Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Ausgaben' || chr(92)) THEN replace(substr(p, 24), chr(92), ' › ')
         ELSE replace(p, chr(92), ' › ') END AS __text
FROM (
  SELECT array_to_string((string_to_array(t.category_path, chr(92)))[1:3], chr(92)) AS p
  FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person = 'joint'
  WHERE t.flow_type = 'consumption'
  UNION
  SELECT array_to_string((string_to_array(t.category_path, chr(92)))[1:4], chr(92))
  FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person = 'joint'
  WHERE t.flow_type = 'consumption' AND cardinality(string_to_array(t.category_path, chr(92))) >= 4
) x
WHERE p IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Burnrate Haushalt (Konsum je Monat)
panels.description: Haushalt = Konsum Ich + Konsum Gemeinschaftskonto. Überträge zwischen beiden sind nie Konsum und werden nicht doppelt gezählt. Mama ist nie enthalten.

targets.rawSql:
WITH links AS (
  SELECT tl.tx_a_id AS tx, tl.tx_b_id AS other FROM transfer_links tl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tl.tx_b_id, tl.tx_a_id FROM transfer_links tl
),
counter AS (
  SELECT l.tx, MIN(a2.person) AS person
  FROM links l
  JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.id = l.other
  JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = t2.account_id
  GROUP BY l.tx
),
tx AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, a.person AS side, t.amount_cents AS cents,
         CASE
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'income' THEN 'income'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'consumption' THEN 'consumption'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IN ('me', 'joint') AND cp.person <> a.person THEN 'cross'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IS NULL AND a.person = 'joint' AND t.amount_cents > 0
             THEN 'extern'
         END AS kind
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person IN ('me', 'joint')
  LEFT JOIN counter cp ON cp.tx = t.id
  WHERE t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(MIN(mon), MAX(mon), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM tx
),
m AS (
  SELECT months.mon, sides.side,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'income'), 0) AS inc,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'consumption'), 0) AS con,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents < 0), 0) AS xout,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents > 0), 0) AS xin,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'extern'), 0) AS ext
  FROM months
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('me'), ('joint')) AS sides (side)
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.mon = months.mon AND tx.side = sides.side
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
b AS (
  SELECT mon, -SUM(con) AS burn
  FROM m
  WHERE side IN ('me', 'joint')
  GROUP BY mon
),
w AS (
  SELECT mon, burn,
         AVG(burn) OVER (ORDER BY mon ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma3,
         AVG(burn) OVER (ORDER BY mon ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma12,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mon) AS n
  FROM b
)
SELECT mon AS time,
       burn / 100.0 AS "Konsum",
       CASE WHEN n >= 3 THEN ma3 / 100.0 END AS "Ø 3 Monate",
       CASE WHEN n >= 12 THEN ma12 / 100.0 END AS "Ø 12 Monate"
FROM w
WHERE $__timeFilter(mon)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Effektive Belastung Ich
panels.description: Überträge zwischen Ich und Gemeinschaftskonto sind Umbuchungen mit Gegenbuchung (transfer_links). Belastung = eigener Konsum + Überträge ans Gemeinschaftskonto − Rückflüsse vom Gemeinschaftskonto.

targets.rawSql:
WITH links AS (
  SELECT tl.tx_a_id AS tx, tl.tx_b_id AS other FROM transfer_links tl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tl.tx_b_id, tl.tx_a_id FROM transfer_links tl
),
counter AS (
  SELECT l.tx, MIN(a2.person) AS person
  FROM links l
  JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.id = l.other
  JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = t2.account_id
  GROUP BY l.tx
),
tx AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, a.person AS side, t.amount_cents AS cents,
         CASE
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'income' THEN 'income'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'consumption' THEN 'consumption'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IN ('me', 'joint') AND cp.person <> a.person THEN 'cross'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IS NULL AND a.person = 'joint' AND t.amount_cents > 0
             THEN 'extern'
         END AS kind
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person IN ('me', 'joint')
  LEFT JOIN counter cp ON cp.tx = t.id
  WHERE t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(MIN(mon), MAX(mon), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM tx
),
m AS (
  SELECT months.mon, sides.side,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'income'), 0) AS inc,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'consumption'), 0) AS con,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents < 0), 0) AS xout,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents > 0), 0) AS xin,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'extern'), 0) AS ext
  FROM months
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('me'), ('joint')) AS sides (side)
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.mon = months.mon AND tx.side = sides.side
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
b AS (
  SELECT mon, -con AS own, -xout AS to_joint, xin AS from_joint, -(con + xout + xin) AS burden
  FROM m
  WHERE side = 'me'
),
w AS (
  SELECT b.*, AVG(burden) OVER (ORDER BY mon ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma12,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mon) AS n
  FROM b
)
SELECT mon AS time,
       own / 100.0 AS "Eigener Konsum",
       to_joint / 100.0 AS "An Gemeinschaftskonto",
       -from_joint / 100.0 AS "Zurück vom Gemeinschaftskonto",
       burden / 100.0 AS "Belastung",
       CASE WHEN n >= 12 THEN ma12 / 100.0 END AS "Belastung Ø 12 Monate"
FROM w
WHERE $__timeFilter(mon)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Deckung: Notgroschen / Belastung
panels.description: Notgroschen am Monatsende geteilt durch die effektive Belastung Ich im Schnitt der letzten 12 Monate.

targets.rawSql:
WITH links AS (
  SELECT tl.tx_a_id AS tx, tl.tx_b_id AS other FROM transfer_links tl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tl.tx_b_id, tl.tx_a_id FROM transfer_links tl
),
counter AS (
  SELECT l.tx, MIN(a2.person) AS person
  FROM links l
  JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.id = l.other
  JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = t2.account_id
  GROUP BY l.tx
),
tx AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, a.person AS side, t.amount_cents AS cents,
         CASE
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'income' THEN 'income'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'consumption' THEN 'consumption'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IN ('me', 'joint') AND cp.person <> a.person THEN 'cross'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IS NULL AND a.person = 'joint' AND t.amount_cents > 0
             THEN 'extern'
         END AS kind
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person IN ('me', 'joint')
  LEFT JOIN counter cp ON cp.tx = t.id
  WHERE t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(MIN(mon), MAX(mon), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM tx
),
m AS (
  SELECT months.mon, sides.side,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'income'), 0) AS inc,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'consumption'), 0) AS con,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents < 0), 0) AS xout,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents > 0), 0) AS xin,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'extern'), 0) AS ext
  FROM months
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('me'), ('joint')) AS sides (side)
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.mon = months.mon AND tx.side = sides.side
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
b AS (
  SELECT mon, -(con + xout + xin) AS burden FROM m WHERE side = 'me'
),
w AS (
  SELECT mon, AVG(burden) OVER (ORDER BY mon ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma12,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mon) AS n
  FROM b
),
pts AS (SELECT mon, LEAST(mon + interval '1 month', now()::timestamp) AS t FROM w WHERE n >= 12),
ng AS (
  SELECT pts.mon, SUM(COALESCE(b.balance_cents, 0) + COALESCE(d.c, 0)) AS c
  FROM pts
  CROSS JOIN accounts a
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ab.balance_cents, ab.balance_at, ab.source FROM account_balances ab
    WHERE ab.account_id = a.id AND ab.currency = 'EUR' AND ab.balance_at <= pts.t
    ORDER BY ab.balance_at DESC LIMIT 1
  ) b ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tx.amount_cents), 0) AS c FROM transactions tx
    WHERE tx.account_id = a.id AND tx.currency = 'EUR' AND tx.booking_date < pts.t::date
      AND (tx.booking_date > b.balance_at::date OR (b.source <> 'observed' AND tx.booking_date = b.balance_at::date))
  ) d ON b.balance_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE a.id IN (${notgroschen:csv})
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT w.mon AS time,
       ng.c / NULLIF(w.ma12, 0) AS "Monate Deckung",
       ng.c / 100.0 AS "Notgroschen (Monatsende)",
       w.ma12 / 100.0 AS "Belastung Ø 12 Monate"
FROM w
JOIN ng ON ng.mon = w.mon
WHERE $__timeFilter(w.mon)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gemeinschaftskonto: Zuflüsse und Konsum
panels.description: Überträge zwischen Ich und Gemeinschaftskonto sind Umbuchungen mit Gegenbuchung (transfer_links). Zufluss ohne Gegenbuchung = Umbuchung aufs Gemeinschaftskonto ohne getrackte Gegenseite, überwiegend die Partnerin. Einnahmen auf dem Gemeinschaftskonto sind z. B. Kindergeld.

WITH links AS (

),
counter AS (
  SELECT l.tx, MIN(a2.person) AS person
  FROM links l
  JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.id = l.other
  JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = t2.account_id
  GROUP BY l.tx
),
tx AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, a.person AS side, t.amount_cents AS cents,
         CASE
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'income' THEN 'income'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'consumption' THEN 'consumption'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IN ('me', 'joint') AND cp.person <> a.person THEN 'cross'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IS NULL AND a.person = 'joint' AND t.amount_cents > 0
             THEN 'extern'
         END AS kind
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person IN ('me', 'joint')
  LEFT JOIN counter cp ON cp.tx = t.id
  WHERE t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(MIN(mon), MAX(mon), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM tx
),
m AS (
  SELECT months.mon, sides.side,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'income'), 0) AS inc,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'consumption'), 0) AS con,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents < 0), 0) AS xout,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents > 0), 0) AS xin,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'extern'), 0) AS ext
  FROM months
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('me'), ('joint')) AS sides (side)
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.mon = months.mon AND tx.side = sides.side
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT mon AS time,
       xin / 100.0 AS "Von Ich",
       ext / 100.0 AS "Zufluss ohne Gegenbuchung",
       inc / 100.0 AS "Einnahmen",
       con / 100.0 AS "Konsum",
       xout / 100.0 AS "An Ich"
FROM m
WHERE side = 'joint' AND $__timeFilter(mon)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Saldo Gemeinschaftskonto
panels.description: Saldo am Monatsende aus der Saldenhistorie, ohne Depot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp), date_trunc('month', now()), interval '1 month') AS t
)
SELECT pts.t - interval '1 day' AS time,
       SUM(COALESCE(b.balance_cents, 0) + COALESCE(d.c, 0)) / 100.0 AS "Saldo Gemeinschaftskonto (Monatsende)"
FROM pts
CROSS JOIN accounts a
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ab.balance_cents, ab.balance_at, ab.source FROM account_balances ab
    WHERE ab.account_id = a.id AND ab.currency = 'EUR' AND ab.balance_at <= pts.t
    ORDER BY ab.balance_at DESC LIMIT 1
  ) b ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tx.amount_cents), 0) AS c FROM transactions tx
    WHERE tx.account_id = a.id AND tx.currency = 'EUR' AND tx.booking_date < pts.t::date
      AND (tx.booking_date > b.balance_at::date OR (b.source <> 'observed' AND tx.booking_date = b.balance_at::date))
  ) d ON b.balance_at IS NOT NULL
WHERE a.person = 'joint' AND NOT a.portfolio AND a.currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'income'), 0) AS inc,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'consumption'), 0) AS con,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents < 0), 0) AS xout,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents > 0), 0) AS xin,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'extern'), 0) AS ext
  FROM months
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('me'), ('joint')) AS sides (side)
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.mon = months.mon AND tx.side = sides.side
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)

       inc / 100.0 AS "Einnahmen",
       con / 100.0 AS "Konsum",
       xout / 100.0 AS "An Gemeinschaftskonto",
       xin / 100.0 AS "Von Gemeinschaftskonto",
       (inc + con + xout + xin + ext) / 100.0 AS "Netto"
FROM m
WHERE side = 'me' AND $__timeFilter(mon)
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH links AS (
  SELECT tl.tx_a_id AS tx, tl.tx_b_id AS other FROM transfer_links tl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tl.tx_b_id, tl.tx_a_id FROM transfer_links tl
),
counter AS (
  SELECT l.tx, MIN(a2.person) AS person
  FROM links l
  JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.id = l.other
  JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = t2.account_id
  GROUP BY l.tx
),
tx AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, a.person AS side, t.amount_cents AS cents,

           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IS NULL AND a.person = 'joint' AND t.amount_cents > 0
             THEN 'extern'
         END AS kind
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person IN ('me', 'joint')
  LEFT JOIN counter cp ON cp.tx = t.id
  WHERE t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(MIN(mon), MAX(mon), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM tx
),
m AS (
  SELECT months.mon, sides.side,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'income'), 0) AS inc,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'consumption'), 0) AS con,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents < 0), 0) AS xout,

         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'extern'), 0) AS ext
  FROM months
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('me'), ('joint')) AS sides (side)
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.mon = months.mon AND tx.side = sides.side
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT mon AS time,
       inc / 100.0 AS "Einnahmen",
       con / 100.0 AS "Konsum",
       xout / 100.0 AS "An Ich",
       xin / 100.0 AS "Von Ich",
       ext / 100.0 AS "Zufluss ohne Gegenbuchung",
       (inc + con + xout + xin + ext) / 100.0 AS "Netto"
FROM m
WHERE side = 'joint' AND $__timeFilter(mon)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monatsübersicht je Seite
panels.description: Überträge zwischen Ich und Gemeinschaftskonto sind Umbuchungen mit Gegenbuchung (transfer_links). Zufluss ohne Gegenbuchung = Umbuchung aufs Gemeinschaftskonto ohne getrackte Gegenseite, überwiegend die Partnerin. Haushalt: Überträge zwischen den Seiten heben sich auf und fehlen daher.

targets.rawSql:
WITH links AS (
  SELECT tl.tx_a_id AS tx, tl.tx_b_id AS other FROM transfer_links tl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tl.tx_b_id, tl.tx_a_id FROM transfer_links tl
),
counter AS (
  SELECT l.tx, MIN(a2.person) AS person
  FROM links l
  JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.id = l.other
  JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = t2.account_id
  GROUP BY l.tx
),
tx AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, a.person AS side, t.amount_cents AS cents,
         CASE
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'income' THEN 'income'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'consumption' THEN 'consumption'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IN ('me', 'joint') AND cp.person <> a.person THEN 'cross'
           WHEN t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND cp.person IS NULL AND a.person = 'joint' AND t.amount_cents > 0
             THEN 'extern'
         END AS kind
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person IN ('me', 'joint')
  LEFT JOIN counter cp ON cp.tx = t.id
  WHERE t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(MIN(mon), MAX(mon), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM tx
),
m AS (
  SELECT months.mon, sides.side,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'income'), 0) AS inc,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'consumption'), 0) AS con,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents < 0), 0) AS xout,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'cross' AND tx.cents > 0), 0) AS xin,
         COALESCE(SUM(tx.cents) FILTER (WHERE tx.kind = 'extern'), 0) AS ext
  FROM months
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('me'), ('joint')) AS sides (side)
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.mon = months.mon AND tx.side = sides.side
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
rows AS (
  SELECT mon, CASE side WHEN 'me' THEN '1 Ich' ELSE '2 Gemeinschaftskonto' END AS seite,
         inc, con, xout, xin, ext, inc + con + xout + xin + ext AS net
  FROM m
  UNION ALL
  -- Household: transfers between the sides cancel and are left out, never double-counted.
  SELECT mon, '3 Haushalt', SUM(inc), SUM(con), NULL, NULL, SUM(ext), SUM(inc + con + ext)
  FROM m
  GROUP BY mon
)
SELECT mon AS "Monat", substr(seite, 3) AS "Seite",
       inc / 100.0 AS "Einnahmen",
       -con / 100.0 AS "Konsum",
       -xout / 100.0 AS "An andere Seite",
       xin / 100.0 AS "Von anderer Seite",
       ext / 100.0 AS "Zufluss ohne Gegenbuchung",
       net / 100.0 AS "Netto"
FROM rows
WHERE $__timeFilter(mon)
ORDER BY mon DESC, seite

panels.title: Laufende Kosten vs. Zufluss (Ø je Monat im Zeitraum)
panels.description: Nur Konsum auf dem Gemeinschaftskonto. Laufend = ohne einmalige Buchungen (Betrag ab $einmalgrenze €; Wohnen › Wohnung zählt nur als laufend, wenn die Buchung wiederkehrend ist, z. B. die Miete) und ohne die Kategorien in $ausgeschlossen. Die Auswahl umfasst Ebene 3 und Ebene 4, weil Reisen als Transport › Reisen auf Ebene 4 liegt; eine Ebene-3-Auswahl schließt alle Unterkategorien ein. Mit dem eigenen Budget vergleichen: es steht bewusst nicht im Dashboard. Zufluss = Überträge von Ich + Zufluss ohne Gegenbuchung + Einnahmen des Gemeinschaftskontos. Überträge ab der Einmalgrenze zählen nur, wenn derselbe Betrag in mindestens 3 Monaten vorkommt; einmalige Aufstockungen bleiben draußen. Schnitt über die vollen Monate des Zeitraums.

targets.rawSql:
WITH jc AS (
  SELECT t.booking_date, date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, t.amount_cents, t.category_path,
         t.merchant_id,
         starts_with(COALESCE(t.category_path, ''), 'Ein-/Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Wohnen' || chr(92) || 'Wohnung') AS housing,
         ABS(t.amount_cents) >= COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(${einmalgrenze:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint, 800) * 100
           AND NOT (starts_with(COALESCE(t.category_path, ''), 'Ein-/Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Wohnen' || chr(92) || 'Wohnung') AND t.recurring) AS oneoff,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[${ausgeschlossen:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS x (p)
           WHERE starts_with(COALESCE(t.category_path, '') || chr(92), x.p || chr(92))
         ) AS excl
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person = 'joint'
  WHERE t.flow_type = 'consumption' AND t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
links AS (
  SELECT tl.tx_a_id AS tx, tl.tx_b_id AS other FROM transfer_links tl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tl.tx_b_id, tl.tx_a_id FROM transfer_links tl
),
counter AS (
  SELECT l.tx, MIN(a2.person) AS person
  FROM links l
  JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.id = l.other
  JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = t2.account_id
  GROUP BY l.tx
),
jin AS (
  SELECT t.booking_date, t.amount_cents,
         CASE WHEN cp.person = 'me' THEN 'von_ich' WHEN cp.person IS NULL THEN 'ohne' END AS src
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person = 'joint'
  LEFT JOIN counter cp ON cp.tx = t.id
  WHERE t.flow_type = 'internal_transfer' AND t.amount_cents > 0 AND t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
-- An inflow at or above the limit is a one-off top-up unless its exact amount recurs in 3+ months.
freq AS (
  SELECT src, amount_cents, COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', booking_date)) AS months
  FROM jin
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
regular AS (
  SELECT jin.src, jin.booking_date, jin.amount_cents
  FROM jin JOIN freq ON freq.src = jin.src AND freq.amount_cents = jin.amount_cents
  WHERE jin.amount_cents < COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(${einmalgrenze:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint, 800) * 100 OR freq.months >= 3
),
inc AS (
  SELECT t.booking_date, t.amount_cents
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person = 'joint'
  WHERE t.flow_type = 'income' AND t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
),
n AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS months
  FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp), date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamp),
                       interval '1 month') AS g (mon)
  WHERE '${laufend}' = 'ja' OR g.mon < date_trunc('month', now())
),
s AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT -SUM(amount_cents) FROM jc WHERE NOT oneoff AND NOT excl AND $__timeFilter(booking_date)) AS running,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM regular WHERE src = 'von_ich' AND $__timeFilter(booking_date)) AS von_ich,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM regular WHERE src = 'ohne' AND $__timeFilter(booking_date)) AS ohne,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM inc WHERE $__timeFilter(booking_date)) AS income
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.running, 0) / 100.0 / NULLIF(n.months, 0) AS "Laufende Kosten Ø/Monat",
       COALESCE(s.von_ich, 0) / 100.0 / NULLIF(n.months, 0) AS "Von Ich Ø/Monat",
       COALESCE(s.ohne, 0) / 100.0 / NULLIF(n.months, 0) AS "Ohne Gegenbuchung Ø/Monat",
       COALESCE(s.income, 0) / 100.0 / NULLIF(n.months, 0) AS "Einnahmen Ø/Monat",
       (COALESCE(s.von_ich, 0) + COALESCE(s.ohne, 0) + COALESCE(s.income, 0) - COALESCE(s.running, 0))
         / 100.0 / NULLIF(n.months, 0) AS "Zufluss − laufende Kosten Ø/Monat"
FROM s, n

),
months AS (SELECT generate_series(MIN(mon), MAX(mon), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM jc),
r AS (

panels.title: Herausgenommene Buchungen
panels.description: Was aus den laufenden Kosten herausfällt: einmalige Buchungen und ausgeschlossene Kategorien. Händlernamen nur für Unternehmen, Privatpersonen bleiben anonym.

targets.rawSql:
WITH jc AS (
  SELECT t.booking_date, date_trunc('month', t.booking_date)::timestamp AS mon, t.amount_cents, t.category_path,
         t.merchant_id,
         starts_with(COALESCE(t.category_path, ''), 'Ein-/Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Wohnen' || chr(92) || 'Wohnung') AS housing,
         ABS(t.amount_cents) >= COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(${einmalgrenze:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint, 800) * 100
           AND NOT (starts_with(COALESCE(t.category_path, ''), 'Ein-/Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Wohnen' || chr(92) || 'Wohnung') AND t.recurring) AS oneoff,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[${ausgeschlossen:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS x (p)
           WHERE starts_with(COALESCE(t.category_path, '') || chr(92), x.p || chr(92))
         ) AS excl
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.person = 'joint'
  WHERE t.flow_type = 'consumption' AND t.currency = 'EUR' AND ('${laufend}' = 'ja' OR t.booking_date < date_trunc('month', now()))
)
SELECT jc.booking_date AS "Datum",
       -jc.amount_cents / 100.0 AS "Betrag",
       CASE WHEN jc.category_path IS NULL THEN '(ohne Kategorie)'
         WHEN starts_with(jc.category_path, 'Ein-/Ausgaben' || chr(92) || 'Ausgaben' || chr(92)) THEN replace(substr(jc.category_path, 24), chr(92), ' › ')
         ELSE replace(jc.category_path, chr(92), ' › ') END AS "Kategorie",
       CASE WHEN m.kind = 'business' THEN m.display_name
            WHEN m.id IS NULL THEN '(ohne Händler)'
            ELSE 'Privatperson' END AS "Händler",
       CASE WHEN jc.excl THEN 'Kategorie ausgeschlossen'
            WHEN jc.housing THEN 'Wohnung, nicht wiederkehrend (über Grenze)'
            ELSE 'Einmalig (über Grenze)' END AS "Grund"
FROM jc
LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = jc.merchant_id
WHERE (jc.oneoff OR jc.excl) AND $__timeFilter(jc.booking_date)
ORDER BY 1 DESC
